title: Grading scale
description: The `scale` global (_data/scale.json): letter-grade bands — the grading scale Meredith College requires on every syllabus, rendered by the `<grading>` component. Bands are a MINIMUM, not a closed range: closed integer ranges (90–100, 80–89, …) leave every fractional average between them unassigned, so a weighted 89.5 belonged to no letter. `min` reads "this score and above"; the failing band carries `max` instead and reads "below that score". Key order is display order — keep letters descending.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, for editor validation.

min.description: Lowest weighted average that earns this letter (inclusive).

max.description: Failing band only: every average below this score.
